en.html:
Sagami Bay—
No. Farther out. Over the Pacific?

One column of light, far taller than the others, was blasting upward.

High. Past the clouds. Farther still.
As if something was being pushed right to the end of the sky.

相模湾――
　いやもっと先、太平洋上か。

en.html:
《Life or death: I ask myself the question I must answer.》
《Then raise the curtain of comedy upon the delighted whirlpool of mockery.》

《The dog howling through the storm-night fights the foolish thief with courage.》
《The chick waiting in its warm nest for its parent sleeps peacefully inside the serpent.》
《The lion born in dappled sunlight eats its fill of thousands of deer.》
《The frog eggs listening to the brook are gathered by a child and crushed underfoot.》
《You who believe in life's meaning, hear the clown's most sincere dishonesty.》
《You who tremble before death, the devil's mask is a mirror painted black.》
《Question life, and clown and devil arrive carrying spoons.》
《Trust life and drown in it, and clown and devil remove their crowns.》
《O beast, dance! Run the fields! Sing, shout, rage and roam!》
《Every chain and every cage before you is now only crumbling mud.》

《Between life and death, laugh at yourself until the self is forgotten in ecstasy.》
《Then let dawn's lament become the bell, and raise the curtain upon the divine comedy.》

《The saint who performs miracles saves mankind, curses God, and vomits.》
《The conqueror in the golden helm wins ten thousand miles and sinks beneath the river with his beloved horse.》
《The beauty of the lake abandons her kingdom for love, then drowns in filth and dies condemned.》
《The orphaned infant drinks earthworm blood as mother's milk and rots from the belly after three nights.》
《O life, hear this anthem: grievance piled upon laughter exhausted from laughing.》
《O life, hear this prayer: joy trembling with anger beneath its head.》
《A hundred-year life may wear rings of fire and swords as decoration.》
《A seven-day life may shine innocent, guarded by darkness and silence.》
《O beast, dance! Run the fields! Sing, shout, rage and roam!》
《Every chain and every cage before you is now only crumbling mud.》
